description:
Extend a lock you currently hold, before its lease runs out — call
    this instead of aanet_acquire_lock again while work is still in
    progress. Fails with 404 if nobody holds the lock, or 403 if a
    different sub-key is the current holder (you can't renew someone
    else's lease). Returns {lease_expires_at}.

api_key.description: Bearer credential for this workspace: either the owner_key returned once by aanet_create_workspace/aanet_create_trial_workspace, or a sub-key returned by aanet_mint_subkey. Sent under the hood as `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`. Owner-only tools reject a sub-key with a 403.
api_key.title: Api Key

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry-safety token (any unique string, e.g. a UUID). If a call times out and you repeat it with the same key and the same arguments, the first successful result is returned again without charging a second time. Keys are remembered for 24 hours, per sub-key. Reusing a key with different arguments is an error (code=IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED).
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

lease_seconds.description: New lease duration from now, 1-3600 seconds.
lease_seconds.title: Lease Seconds

name.description: Lock name — must match a lock you currently hold.
name.title: Name

workspace_id.description: The workspace_id from aanet_create_workspace or aanet_create_trial_workspace.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: aanet_renew_lock
